step1.title: Streaming SolidJS: Routing
step1.description:
This stream is going to look at control flow and routing in Solid, and go over the approach we've taken with Solid App Router.

The next generation of Jamstack performance is… less JS! -  Yang Zhang https://youtu.be/U28rjWrGVxk?list=PL58Wk5g77lF-XaNacKxWk7yOKgeCMveAS
How SPAs Ruined the Web - Rich Harris https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=860d8usGC0o
Before You Memo - By Dan Abramov https://overreacted.io/before-you-memo/

[0:00] Introduction/This Week in JavaScript
[24:00] Rendering lists in Solid
[52:00] Simple routing
[58:05] Solid App Router
[1:13:07] Navigation Aware Data Fetching
[1:37:20] Suspense vs Transitions
